dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent 4-5 structures exhibit irregular, convoluted light-intensity perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from a silvery-white exterior to a dark-gray interior. The perimeters are characterized by jagged, non-uniform pixel boundaries forming closed 'O' shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, low-intensity dark clusters centered within the light-colored annuli. These blobs represent solid-color concentrations without internal gradients, forming a repetitive cellular network across the dorsal and upper-lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest dorsal annuli form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral. A primary triangular spatial relationship exists between the three most anterior clusters, forming an obtuse angle oriented towards the posterior section.
